ev.q: whistlers reproduce the melody of ordinary speech rather than inventing new words

1.why: B段讲口哨语言的原理：把现有口语的旋律吹出来。viii Speech turned into melody ↔ reproduce the melody of ordinary speech。iii 与原文相反：A whistled language is not a secret code；x 是细节陷阱：段中提到声调语言，但没说它们更难吹。

ev.q: Most are found in mountainous areas or in dense forest, where people working on the land are often far apart

2.why: C段讲口哨语言出现在哪类环境：山区、密林，人们相距很远。iv Places where distance and terrain favour whistling ↔ mountainous areas or in dense forest, where people … are often far apart。ii 是例子段A的标题，C段讲的是多个地方的共同特点。

ev.q: In most of these places, whistling is now in decline.

3.why: D段：道路、年轻人外流、手机让口哨语言衰落。ix Modern life and a fading skill ↔ in decline … Roads … mobile phones … few young people could whistle fluently。

ev.q: Not everyone regards this as a complete success.

4.why: E段：La Gomera 通过学校复兴了 Silbo，但 Quintero 认为它主要变成了表演。v A recovery that some consider incomplete ↔ revival … Not everyone regards this as a complete success。vi 是细节陷阱：段中只说表演吸引游客，没有说游客学吹口哨。

ev.q: whistled Turkish was processed by the left and right hemispheres to a similar degree

5.why: F段：口语通常主要由左脑处理，而口哨土耳其语左右脑处理程度相近，出乎意料。vii An unexpected pattern of activity in the head ↔ In most people … left hemisphere … however … left and right hemispheres to a similar degree。i 过度推断：原文只说 could eventually help in understanding，并不是“治疗方法”。

ev.q: Here vowels are represented by higher or lower notes, while consonants appear as breaks, slides and sudden changes in the sound.

6.why: B段。B shows vowels through pitch and consonants through changes in the whistle ↔ vowels are represented by higher or lower notes, while consonants appear as breaks, slides and sudden changes。C 是陷阱：跟着声调走的是声调语言，原文说西班牙语 is not tonal；D 与 carries less information than speech 相反。

ev.q: the language now survives mainly as a performance, something to be shown at festivals and in classrooms, rather than as a practical means of communication

7.why: E段末句。B displayed more than it is actually used ↔ survives mainly as a performance … rather than as a practical means of communication。A 错：原文说大多数孩子都学会了基础；C 原文没说旅游是威胁。

ev.q: For centuries the island's shepherds have communicated over these distances by whistling

8.why: A段。send messages across the island ↔ communicated over these distances。C段的 farmers 是土耳其 Kuşköy 的人，不是 La Gomera。

ev.q: whistlers reproduce the melody of ordinary speech rather than inventing new words

9.why: B段。Rather than creating new words ↔ rather than inventing new words；copy ↔ reproduce。B段后面的 tones 只适用于声调语言，不是所有口哨语言的共同点。

ev.q: people in the village of Aas, high in the French Pyrenees, communicated in a whistled form of Occitan

10.why: C段。Up to around a century ago ↔ Until about a hundred years ago。不要填 Turkish（那是 Kuşköy）或 French（Aas 虽然在法国，吹的却是地方语言 Occitan）。

ev.q: whistling is also used by hunters, who can communicate without frightening the animals they are following

11.why: C段末句。parts of South America ↔ parts of the Amazon rainforest；do not scare their prey ↔ without frightening the animals they are following。farmers 是土耳其的例子。

ev.q: in 1999 the regional government made it a compulsory subject in all of the island's primary schools

12.why: E段。have had to study ↔ made it a compulsory subject。classrooms 也在E段出现，但那是 Quintero 说 Silbo 被“展示”的场所，不是1999年规定必修的地方。

ev.q: whistled Turkish was processed by the left and right hemispheres to a similar degree

13.why: F段。the two ___ of the brain ↔ the left and right hemispheres；equally ↔ to a similar degree。
